sections.name: Launch
sections.note: Wide opening; rings teach the line before the first route choice.

sections.name: Broad sweeps
sections.note: First split: A offers a 9-tile line with 2 branch rings; B narrows to 7 tiles for 4.

sections.name: Branching slalom
sections.note: A flows through broad bends with 3 branch rings; B changes direction more sharply for 7.

sections.name: Recovery straight
sections.note: Three holes interrupt the straight. The six shared rings guide right → left → right around them.

sections.name: Technical finale
sections.note: Three paths: A is 7 tiles wide / 2 branch rings; B is 5 tiles / 6; C is 5 tiles / 4.

sections.name: Finish sprint
sections.note: Three holes: one before the split, one on wider path A, and one after the merge. Rings guide around each; the last 21 units stay clear.
